req.title: Cookie name path segment escaping
req.statement: The system shall percent-decode the <name> and <value> path segments in /cookies/set/<name>/<value>.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /cookies/set/<name>/<value> must percent-decode the name and value path segments. Flask/Werkzeug automatically percent-decodes path segments before passing them to the route handler, so the handler receives the decoded strings. Tests must verify: (1) a normal cookie name/value is set correctly (EP positive), (2) a percent-encoded name/value is decoded and set correctly (EP positive with encoding), (3) a percent-encoded space (%20) in name and value is decoded to a literal space (BVA), (4) a percent-encoded special character like %2F (slash) is decoded correctly (BVA), (5) an empty-string-equivalent or single-char boundary name is handled (BVA), and (6) a cookie name that would be invalid if NOT decoded is tested (NEG path). We drive the Flask test client in-process, follow the redirect to /cookies, and assert the exact cookie name and value in the JSON response. The redirect chain: /cookies/set/<name>/<value> -> 302 -> /cookies returns JSON {"cookies": {name: value}}.

tests.name: test_set_cookie_plain_name_value
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
No prior cookies set in client session
expected: Exactly the decoded name and value appear in the cookies dict
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: set_cookie handler receives decoded name/value from Flask routing
Redirect to /cookies returns JSON with the cookie
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
app.config['TESTING'] = True

def test_set_cookie_plain_name_value():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/mycookie/myvalue', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies'].get('mycookie') == 'myvalue'
    assert len([k for k in data['cookies'] if k == 'mycookie']) == 1

test_set_cookie_plain_value = test_set_cookie_plain_name_value
test_set_cookie_plain_name_value()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_name_and_value
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Verify the cookie name is 'my cookie' and value is 'my value'
expected: JSON cookies dict contains key 'my cookie' with value 'my value'
Percent-encoding %20 is decoded to space character
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: path segment percent-decoding must convert %20 -> space
Flask/Werkzeug decodes path before passing to set_cookie(name, value)
set_cookie uses decoded name and value in r.set_cookie()
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
app.config['TESTING'] = True

def test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_name_and_value():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/my%20cookie/my%20value', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert 'my cookie' in data['cookies'], f"Expected 'my cookie' in {data['cookies']}"
    assert data['cookies']['my cookie'] == 'my value'
    assert 'my%20cookie' not in data['cookies']

test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_name_and_value()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_special_chars
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Client sends percent-encoded special characters in name and value
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: percent-decode applies to any percent-encoded octet in path segments
Flask routing decodes %21->! and %40->@ before handler receives them
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
app.config['TESTING'] = True

def test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_special_chars():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/test%21name/test%40value', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert 'test!name' in data['cookies'], f"Expected 'test!name' in {data['cookies']}"
    assert data['cookies']['test!name'] == 'test@value'
    assert 'test%21name' not in data['cookies']
    assert 'test%40value' not in data['cookies'].values()

test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_special_chars()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_digit_sequence
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Name and value contain percent-encoded digits %31%32%33 (123)
expected: Percent-encoded digit sequences are decoded to their ASCII characters
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: BVA — percent-encoded digits boundary, verifies decoding is applied to numeric ASCII codes
Catches mutations that skip decoding or apply it only to letters
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
app.config['TESTING'] = True

def test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_digit_sequence():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/%31%32%33/%34%35%36', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert '123' in data['cookies'], f"Expected '123' in {data['cookies']}"
    assert data['cookies']['123'] == '456'
    assert '%31%32%33' not in data['cookies']
    assert data['cookies'].get('123') != '123'

test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_digit_sequence()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_redirect_status_without_follow
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: NEG path — verifies the handler issues exactly a 302 redirect
Catches mutations that change redirect status code or omit Set-Cookie header
Verifies cookie is set in the redirect response itself, not only after following
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
app.config['TESTING'] = True

def test_set_cookie_redirect_status_without_follow():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/negtest/negval', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert '/cookies' in location, f"Expected /cookies in Location, got: {location}"
    set_cookie_header = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert 'negtest' in set_cookie_header, f"Expected 'negtest' in Set-Cookie: {set_cookie_header}"
    assert 'negval' in set_cookie_header, f"Expected 'negval' in Set-Cookie: {set_cookie_header}"
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 301
    assert r.status_code != 303

test_set_cookie_redirect_status_without_follow()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_name_value_not_swapped
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Name and value are distinct strings
actions: Assert name is key and value is the dict value, not swapped
expected: 'cookievalue' is NOT a key in cookies dict
'cookiename' is NOT a value in cookies dict
trace: R-HTTPBIN-044: NEG — catches mutations that swap name and value in set_cookie(key=name, value=value)
Verifies the positional assignment is correct
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
app.config['TESTING'] = True

def test_set_cookie_name_value_not_swapped():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/cookiename/cookievalue', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert 'cookiename' in data['cookies']
    assert data['cookies']['cookiename'] == 'cookievalue'
    assert 'cookievalue' not in data['cookies']
    assert data['cookies'].get('cookievalue') is None

test_set_cookie_name_value_not_swapped()

tests.name: test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_hyphen_underscore
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Name contains percent-encoded hyphen %2D and underscore %5F
trace: Catches mutations that only decode alphanumeric percent sequences
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
app.config['TESTING'] = True

def test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_hyphen_underscore():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set/my%2Dcookie%5Fname/hello%2Dworld', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert 'my-cookie_name' in data['cookies'], f"Got: {data['cookies']}"
    assert data['cookies']['my-cookie_name'] == 'hello-world'
    assert 'my%2Dcookie%5Fname' not in data['cookies']

test_set_cookie_percent_encoded_hyphen_underscore()
